text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To do some shopping,
I visited the shopping street together with Epiphaneia.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Japanese sweets!
I always crave that gentle flavor every now and then!
Wanna go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stepped inside the wagashi shop.
The interior was very quiet.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's nobody here!
choice_data_list: Hmm... maybe they're working in the back?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Maybe! Alright, let's go talk to them.
*inhale*...——

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heeeeeeeeeeeey!!
Is anyone theeeeeere!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was startled by the excessively loud voice in the quiet shop—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(—*CLAAAAAANG!!!!*
*CRASH, CRASH!! CRACK-CRASH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoa!!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Pound, pound!! Pound, pound!!
Pound, pound!! Pound, pound!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
What's happening, what's happening!?
What on earth is this sound~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Pound, pound, pound!!! Pound, pound, pound!!!
Pound, pound, pound!!! Pound, pound, pound!!!)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's not stopping at all... if anything, it's just getting bigger and bigger!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha! Awesome!
This is starting to get really fun!
choice_data_list: Th-this is no time to be saying that—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hm, is something the matter?
What is going on—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Pound, pound, pound!!! Pound, pound, pound!!!
Pound, pound, pound!!! POUUUUUND!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Voice
text_block_list.text: Howaaaaaaa~~~~~~~h!!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAH~~~~~~~!!?

text_block_list.name: Old Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Howaaaa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As the loud noise subsided, a petite elderly man dressed in
samue work clothes came staggering out from the back of the shop.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aren't you... the shopkeeper grandpa?
What on earth happened here, sir?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I see, because I startled you, you ended up hitting the button on the mochi maker!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still—Ahahaha!
What a massive sound that was!
Even I was a little startled!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Are you truly reflecting on your actions?!
Your voice is getting loud again!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
It's not like I want to be mean to the old man!
choice_data_list: Then from now on, be mindful of time, place, and occasion—
Is there anything I can do to make it up to you?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's right!!
Shopkeeper, I am truly, truly sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You're right!
Sorry! I said I'm sorry, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The more they spoke, the louder they got. Realizing this was bad, I cut it short and bowed in apology to the shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...! —Hey, Shopkeeper,
is there anything we can do to help?"

text_block_list.name: Old Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: That ain't it... Well then, eat plenty of our specialty, "Chestnut Kintsuba".

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Chestnut kintsuba?!
Whoa~, that looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, wrap up everything you've got!
I'll share it with everyone and spread the word about how great this shop is!
